text:
anna.peopleops: Quick question — finalizing the review exception/late-submission flow. For EMEA/APAC folks and folks on LOA/PT schedules, we were thinking: accept review forms up to 48 hrs late with a short rationale, reviewers get paired with backups and overflow assigned via a shared queue. OK with everyone?
chris.peopleops: Sounds reasonable. Two Qs: 1) Who signs off on the exception? 2) How do we surface the reason to calibrators without exposing private details?
jenna-eng-mgr: +1 to 48 hrs. For sign-off, managers should approve; if manager unavailable, second reviewer (designated backup) can approve. For privacy, we can accept a checkbox + short freeform note visible only to people-ops and calibration leads.
sam-platform: We should also protect reviewer load — suggest caps: no reviewer >10 direct reports without overflow help. Overflow goes to the "backup reviewer pool". We can auto-assign by round-robin.
anna.peopleops: Good. I'll create the backup pool. Can we run automated reminders 7d/3d/1d before deadlines and a final nudge at 24hrs after deadline (for those in scope)?
calendar-bot: Reminder scheduled: Review reminders set to cron: `0 9 * * 1` (weekly) for general updates. One-off nudges scheduled at 7 days, 3 days, 1 day, and 24hrs post-deadline when applicable.
chris.peopleops: Also: attachment handling — if someone uploads supporting docs after deadline, they should be routed to an attachments queue and reviewers notified. We'll keep a flag on the form for "post-deadline attachment".
jenna-eng-mgr: Can we add a short office-hours rota for managers who want help with writing manager feedback? 2x 30min slots per week across timezones.
anna.peopleops: Yes — I'll publish an office-hours signup (link: https://redwood.in/people/review-office-hours) and a simple reviewer checklist: `- confirm submission window/approval - flag attachments - mark exceptions - assign backup`.
sam-platform: I'll add a script to reassign overflow: `/scripts/assign_overflow --pool backup-reviewers --max 2` — want me to run it nightly?
anna.peopleops: Please do nightly. I'll update the review guidance doc and the forms flow to include the exception checkbox and the backup reviewer field. Final ask: can leads confirm backup reviewers by EOD Friday?
jenna-eng-mgr: Confirmed — I'll add Maya and Rafi to the pool.
chris.peopleops: Confirmed from people-ops side. I'll also add the privacy display rules for calibrators.
anna.peopleops: Thanks all :raised_hands: I'll send the follow-up doc and update the calendar invites.
